item.title: $2 million in drugs tied to Sinaloa Cartel seized by King County Sheriff's office
item.description: Detectives have dismantled a regional drug distribution network tied to the Sinaloa Cartel, seizing drugs with an estimated street value of $2 million.

item.title: Gusty weather in Seattle for Christmas Eve
item.description: Our weather team is monitoring two rounds of winds today: one this morning and a second this afternoon. Plus, we take a look at Christmas Day conditions for the Puget Sound region.

item.title: Things to do Christmas weekend in western WA
item.description: On Christmas week in Seattle, visitors and residents alike will have many options to get out on the town and enjoy holiday cheer.

item.title: US attorneys trace WA investor money to Bellevue real estate scheme
item.description: U.S. attorneys describe a multimillion-dollar real estate fraud scheme that drained tens of thousands of dollars from 22 Washington investors, many of them in the Seattle area.

item.title: Seattle Weather: Cool Showers Christmas Day
item.description: A few showers will be possible into early Saturday with drier skies for the weekend and to end the year. Chilly mornings ahead with some fog developing this weekend and next week.

item.title: Seattle weather: Mountain snow moving in Christmas night
item.description: Christmas Day started off relatively calm with isolated showers. Heading into the overnight hours, up to a foot of snow will roll into the mountain regions for a much needed snowpack boost.

item.title: Gov. Ferguson orders flags lowered for WA trooper killed on duty
item.description: Governor Bob Ferguson has issued a directive requiring all state agencies to lower state and American flags in honor of the WSP trooper killed in the line of duty last week.

item.title: 4 injured by coffee stand car crash in Kitsap County, WA
item.description: Multiple people were hospitalized on the night of Christmas Eve as a car drove straight through a coffee stand in Kitsap County.

item.title: Kent, WA restaurant honors grandmother's legacy with free Christmas meals
item.description: Staff, family and volunteers expected to give out 1,000 free meals in Kent on Christmas Day. The restaurant founder's great-grandchildren talk about Nana's legacy.

item.title: Seattle Weather: Scattered showers Friday, lowering snow levels
item.description: Highs in the mid to low 40s, a few degrees below seasonal average. Scattered showers and mountain snow, possible late lower snowflakes.
